boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UH Libraries environments spanning individual work, group sessions, desktop access, multimedia production, and digital research.

cards.title: 24 Hour Lounge
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library entrance
cards.notes: Set up at the library entrance for group seating and computer access. After posted closing, enter by Cougar Card swipe and keep your card available.
cards.short_summary: A group-seating lounge with overnight Cougar Card access.
cards.evidence_claim: The lounge is in the MD Anderson Library entrance, has group seating, and allows valid Cougar Card holders to enter after posted closing hours.
cards.source_title: 24 Hour Lounge | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: After the library’s posted closing hours, entry requires a valid Cougar Card swipe; security checks cards overnight.

cards.title: North Lab
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, first floor Red Wing
cards.notes: Use a desktop, ADA workstation, printing, or scanning in the Red Wing across from the Service Desk. A CougarNet account is required for library labs.
cards.short_summary: A 36-desktop lab with printing, scanning, and ADA stations.
cards.evidence_claim: North Lab has 36 Windows desktops, four ADA workstations, and printing and scanning; it is on the first floor in the Red Wing.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: A CougarNet account is required for library computer labs.

cards.title: South Lab
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, first floor Gold Wing
cards.notes: Choose among desks, tables, and seating in the Gold Wing behind the Service Desk. Public computers have a three-hour limit and cannot print.
cards.short_summary: Flexible seating beside limited-use public desktops.
cards.evidence_claim: South Lab has varied desks, tables, and seating, three Windows desktops, and includes the Hamill Foundation Multimedia Studio.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public computers have a three-hour limit and printing is unavailable in this lab.

cards.title: Digital Research Commons
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, Brown Wing Room 266-C
cards.notes: Book this second-floor digital-project workspace when a shared workstation, VideoWall, podcast studio, or specialized research software fits the assignment.
cards.short_summary: Appointment-based digital research space with advanced tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The DRC has three group workstations, a lecture area, a VideoWall PC, and a podcast studio in Brown Wing Room 266-C.
cards.source_title: Digital Research Commons | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: Book time through the DRC form or email; use outside business hours can be arranged in advance.

cards.title: Hamill Foundation Multimedia Studio
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, South Lab
cards.notes: Reserve a focused audio-production session in the South Lab for recording or editing. Bring the confirmation email and meet the student sound engineer at the Service Desk.
cards.short_summary: Free reservable audio booths and recording equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The studio is a free UH-community resource with audio booths and professional recording equipment; sessions can total up to two hours.
cards.source_title: Hamill Foundation Multimedia Studio | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservation confirmation is required for entry; all performers must be current UH students, faculty, or staff.

cards.title: Blue Wing Open Carrels
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, floors 3, 5, and 6
cards.notes: Head to the Blue Wing for an individual carrel without a key or time limit. These open carrels are first-come, first-served on three library floors.
cards.short_summary: Key-free individual carrels across three Blue Wing floors.
cards.evidence_claim: Open carrels in the Blue Wing are on floors 3, 5, and 6, need no key, have no time limit, and are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Individual Study Carrels | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: No key or reservation is required; availability is first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Brown Wing Open Carrels
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, floors 2 through 5
cards.notes: Use a Brown Wing carrel for independent work across floors two through five. The open carrels require no key and have no time limit.
cards.short_summary: Individual, key-free carrels on four Brown Wing floors.
cards.evidence_claim: Brown Wing open carrels are on floors 2 through 5, do not require a key, have no time limit, and are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Individual Study Carrels | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: No key or reservation is required; availability is first-come, first-served.

cards.entity_name: MD Anderson Library Reservable Group Rooms
cards.title: MD Anderson Library Reservable Group Rooms
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, floors 1 and 2
cards.notes: Reserve a first- or second-floor group room when your session needs a whiteboard and PC-connected screen. The reserving person picks up the key at the Service Desk.
cards.short_summary: Ten reservable rooms for structured group work.
cards.evidence_claim: MD Anderson Library has 10 reservable group rooms on floors 1 and 2; most rooms have whiteboards and PC-connected screens.
cards.source_title: MD Anderson Library Group Study Rooms | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reserve ahead; the person who reserved must collect the key, and groups are limited to four hours per day.

cards.entity_name: MD Anderson Library Two-person Study Rooms
cards.title: MD Anderson Library Two-person Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: MD Anderson Library, Blue Wing floors 4 through 6
cards.notes: Check out a key from the Service Desk for a Blue Wing room sized for two. Use its whiteboard for a paired review session and return the key afterward.
cards.short_summary: Five key-checkout rooms designed for pairs.
cards.evidence_claim: There are five two-person study rooms in Blue Wing corners on floors 4, 5, and 6, each with a whiteboard.
cards.source_title: MD Anderson Library Group Study Rooms | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: No reservations; check out a key at the Service Desk. Groups are limited to two people and four hours without renewals.

cards.entity_name: Health Sciences Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Health Sciences Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of three rooms for a small group session with a monitor and whiteboard. Bring at least two Cougar Card holders to check out the room.
cards.short_summary: Small-group rooms with a monitor, whiteboard, and checkout kit.
cards.evidence_claim: Health Sciences Library has three group study rooms for 2–6 people, each with a table, chairs, whiteboard, and monitor.
cards.source_title: Health Sciences Library Group Study Rooms | University of Houston Libraries
cards.access_notes: At least two Cougar Card holders are required; reserve up to three hours per day, with one renewal pending availability.
